options.name: branch
options.description: The branch to write a file at. If not specified the default branch will be used instead.

options.name: content
options.description: When used instead of C(src), sets the contents of a file directly to the specified value. Required when U(src) is not provided.

options.name: dest
options.description: Path in Bitbucket repositorywhere the file should be copied to.

options.name: message
options.description: Commit message. If not specified the default message should be used.

options.name: password
options.description: Password used for authentication. This is only needed when not using I(token). Required when I(username) is provided.

options.name: retries
options.description: Number of retries to call Bitbucket API URL before failure.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between API retries.

options.name: src
options.description: Local path to a file to copy to the Bitbucket Server repository. This can be absolute or relative. Required when U(content) is not provided.

options.name: token
options.description: Token parameter for authentication. This is only needed when not using I(username) and I(password).

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for authentication. This is only needed when not using I(token). Required when I(password) is provided.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
